analysis.reason: Preview Drive backend intentionally accepts only synthetic B2 client IDs. Operational client binary writes are not permitted in Preview.

analysis.legacyDriveLinks: Existing cliente.driveLink values are historical references preserved from prior imports/work. The tenant Drive provider is the canonical documentary authority for new documents. A manual historical folder link is not a prerequisite for provider-managed documents.
analysis.directRenewalSupportMeaning: The support is the firm renewal policy/document issued by the insurer or another confirmed documentary reference proving the issued renewal.
analysis.issuanceActionMeaning: This is an internal Ops issuance request; it does not send an email. The prior label implied external sending and was misleading.
